properties.displayName: Alert Event ASIM filtering parser for Wiz Defend (WizDetectionsV3_CL)
properties.query:
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Wiz Defend is Wiz's cloud threat detection and response (TDR) capability.
// Each record in WizDetectionsV3_CL represents a single detection raised
// against one or more triggering events (cloud audit logs, workload traffic,
// identity activity, etc.) correlated by Wiz.
//
// tdrSource can be WIZ, WIZ_SENSOR, GUARD_DUTY or others. This parser is filtering out
// third-party alert products ingested by Wiz (such as AWS GuardDuty), as those should be
// handled by their respective data connectors and parsers.
// -------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ASIM's Hostname logical type is a single DNS label, Regex matches ASIMs data tester
// Wiz primaryResource.name for some VM/container entities holds
// an ARM resource ID, a multi-label FQDN (e.g. AWS EC2 internal DNS names), a VMSS
// instance ID with underscores (e.g. "aks-apps2-16464496-vmss_6"), or other
let HostnameFormatRegex = @'^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$';
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    hostname_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    username_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    attacktactics_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    attacktechniques_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    threatcategory_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    alertverdict_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventseverity_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    WizDetectionsV3_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
            and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where tdrSource contains "WIZ" // Filtering out 3rd party sources such as AWS GuardDuty
    // Filters below use only native columns (severity, mitreTactics, mitreTechniques) and are
    // applied before the extends further down.
    | where array_length(eventseverity_has_any) == 0 or (
        ("High" in (eventseverity_has_any) and severity in ("HIGH", "CRITICAL"))
        or ("Medium" in (eventseverity_has_any) and severity == "MEDIUM")
        or ("Low" in (eventseverity_has_any) and severity == "LOW")
        or ("Informational" in (eventseverity_has_any) and severity == "INFORMATIONAL")
    )
    | where array_length(alertverdict_has_any) == 0 // Data source does not support AlertVerdict
    | where array_length(attacktactics_has_any) == 0 or array_length(set_intersect(mitreTactics, attacktactics_has_any)) > 0
    | where array_length(attacktechniques_has_any) == 0 or array_length(set_intersect(mitreTechniques, attacktechniques_has_any)) > 0
    | extend
        _origin = tostring(triggeringEvents[0].origin),
        _status = tostring(triggeringEvents[0].status),
        _actorType = tostring(primaryActor.type),
        _actorName = tostring(primaryActor.name),
        _actorExternalId = tostring(primaryActor.externalId),
        _actorProviderUniqueId = tostring(primaryActor.providerUniqueId),
        _actorNativeType = tostring(primaryActor.nativeType),
        _resType = tostring(primaryResource.type),
        _resName = tostring(primaryResource.name),
        _resId = tostring(primaryResource.id),
        _resExtId = tostring(primaryResource.externalId),
        _resCloudPlatform = tostring(primaryResource.cloudAccount.cloudPlatform),
        _procId = tostring(triggeringEvents[0].runtimeDetails.processTree[0].id),
        _procPath = tostring(triggeringEvents[0].runtimeDetails.processTree[0].path),
        _procCommand = tostring(triggeringEvents[0].runtimeDetails.processTree[0].command),
        _procHash = tostring(triggeringEvents[0].runtimeDetails.processTree[0].hash),
        _procSize = triggeringEvents[0].runtimeDetails.processTree[0].size
    | extend
        _isAzureArmId = _resCloudPlatform == "Azure" and _resExtId matches regex @'(?i)^/subscriptions/'
    | where array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or _actorName has_any (username_has_any)
    | where array_length(hostname_has_any) == 0 or (
        _resType in ("VIRTUAL_MACHINE", "CONTAINER")
        and _resName has_any (hostname_has_any)
    )
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or (
        _actorType == "NETWORK_ADDRESS"
        and _actorName has_any (ipaddr_has_any_prefix)
    )
    | project-rename
        ThreatId = threatId,
        EventReportUrl = threatUrl
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(todatetime(tostring(timeFrame.startedAt)), createdAt),
        EventEndTime = coalesce(todatetime(tostring(timeFrame.endedAt)), createdAt),
        EventCount = toint(coalesce(triggeringEventsCount, 1)),
        EventType = "Alert",
        EventSubType = "Threat",
        EventProduct = "Defend",
        EventVendor = "Wiz",
        EventSchema = "AlertEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1",
        EventUid = detectionId,
        EventOriginalUid = detectionId,
        EventMessage = iff(isnotempty(description), description, detectionTitle),
        EventOriginalSeverity = severity,
        EventSeverity = case(
            severity == "CRITICAL", "High",
            severity == "HIGH", "High",
            severity == "MEDIUM", "Medium",
            severity == "LOW", "Low",
            severity == "INFORMATIONAL", "Informational",
            "Informational"
        ),
        EventResult = case(
            _status == "Success", "Success",
            _status == "Failure", "Failure",
            "NA"
        ),
        AlertName = detectionTitle,
        ThreatCategory = case(
            detectionTitle has "malware" or tdrId has "malware", "Malware",
            detectionTitle has "ransomware" or tdrId has "ransomware", "Ransomware",
            detectionTitle has "phishing" or tdrId has "phishing", "Phishing",
            detectionTitle has "spyware" or tdrId has "spyware", "Spyware",
            detectionTitle has "rootkit" or tdrId has "rootkit", "Rootkit",
            detectionTitle has "adware" or tdrId has "adware", "Adware",
            detectionTitle has "trojan" or tdrId has "trojan", "Trojan",
            detectionTitle has "worm" or tdrId has "worm", "Worm",
            detectionTitle has "cryptocurrency" or detectionTitle has "cryptomin" or tdrId has "cryptomin", "Cryptominor",
            "Unknown"
        )
    | where array_length(threatcategory_has_any) == 0 or ThreatCategory in (threatcategory_has_any)
    | extend
        RuleName = tdrId,
        DetectionMethod = case(
            _origin == "WIZ_SENSOR", "EDR",
            _origin == "WIZ_AGENTLESS_MALWARE_SCANNING", "Antivirus",
            _origin in (
                "GITHUB_AUDIT_LOGS", "AWS_CLOUDTRAIL", "AZURE_ACTIVITY_LOGS", "AZURE_ACTIVE_DIRECTORY",
                "GCP_AUDIT_LOGS", "GCP_GKE_AUDIT_LOGS", "GCP_STORAGE_DATA_ACCESS_LOGS",
                "GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_AUDIT_LOGS", "OKTA_SYSTEM_LOGS", "WIZ_AUDIT_LOGS",
                "WIZ_KUBERNETES_AUDIT_LOGS_COLLECTOR", "WIZ_WORKLOAD_HTTP_LOGS", "WIZ_WORKLOAD_DATABASE_LOGS",
                "WIZ_WORKLOAD_SSH_LOGS", "WIZ_WORKLOAD_VIRTUAL_APPLIANCE_LOGS"
            ), "Cloud Security Posture Management",
            "Other"
        ),
        AttackTactics = iff(array_length(mitreTactics) > 0, strcat_array(mitreTactics, ", "), ""),
        AttackTechniques = iff(array_length(mitreTechniques) > 0, strcat_array(mitreTechniques, ", "), ""),
        Username = _actorName,
        UserId = case(
            isnotempty(_actorProviderUniqueId), _actorProviderUniqueId,
            isnotempty(_actorExternalId), _actorExternalId,
            tostring(primaryActor.id)
        )
    | extend
        UserIdType = case(
            isempty(UserId), "",
            UserId startswith "arn:", "AWSId",
            "Other"
        ),
        UserType = case(
            _actorType == "SERVICE_ACCOUNT", "Service Principal",
            _actorType in ("USER_ACCOUNT", "IDENTITY"), "Regular",
            "Other"
        ),
        OriginalUserType = _actorNativeType,
        // resId is Wiz's internal hash, not a native identifier, prefer resExtId.
        DvcId = iff(isnotempty(_resExtId), _resExtId, _resId),
        DvcIdType = iff(_isAzureArmId, "AzureResourceId", "Other"),
        DvcScopeId = tostring(primaryResource.cloudAccount.externalId),
        DvcHostname = iff(_resType in ("VIRTUAL_MACHINE", "CONTAINER") and _resName matches regex HostnameFormatRegex, _resName, ""),
        // triggeringEvents[].actorIP is the actor's login/source IP, not the device's
        DvcIpAddr = iff(
            _actorType == "NETWORK_ADDRESS"
            and (
                ipv4_is_match(_actorName, "0.0.0.0", 0)
                or ipv6_is_match(_actorName, "::1", 0)
                or ipv6_is_match(_actorName, "0.0.0.0", 0)
            ),
            _actorName,
            ""
        ),
        DvcAction = tostring(triggeringEvents[0].name),
        IndicatorType = case(
            _resType == "VIRTUAL_MACHINE", "Host",
            isnotempty(_resId), "Cloud Resource",
            ""
        ),
        // Only WIZ_SENSOR (EDR/runtime) detections carry a process tree
        ProcessId = _procId,
        ProcessCommandLine = _procCommand,
        ProcessName = _procPath,
        FileName = extract(@"[^\\/]+$", 0, _procPath),
        FilePath = _procPath,
        FileSHA1 = iff(strlen(_procHash) == 40, _procHash, ""),
        FileSize = tolong(_procSize)
    | extend
        UsernameType = case(
            isempty(Username), "",
            Username has "@", "UPN",
            "Simple"
        ),
        AlertId = EventUid,
        AlertDescription = EventMessage,
        Rule = RuleName,
        Hostname = DvcHostname,
        IpAddr = DvcIpAddr,
        User = Username,
        Dvc = case(
            isnotempty(DvcId), DvcId,
            isnotempty(DvcHostname), DvcHostname,
            isnotempty(DvcIpAddr), DvcIpAddr,
            EventProduct
        )
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack,
            pack(
                "TdrId", tdrId,
                "TdrSource", tdrSource,
                "PrimaryActor", primaryActor,
                "PrimaryResource", primaryResource,
                "CloudAccounts", cloudAccounts,
                "CloudOrganizations", cloudOrganizations,
                // projects is not present in every tenant's WizDetectionsV3_CL schema
                "Projects", column_ifexists("projects", dynamic(null)),
                "Resources", resources,
                "Actors", actors,
                "TriggeringEvents", triggeringEvents
            ),
            dynamic(null)
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        EventStartTime,
        EventEndTime,
        EventCount,
        EventType,
        EventSubType,
        EventResult,
        EventSeverity,
        EventOriginalSeverity,
        EventProduct,
        EventVendor,
        EventSchema,
        EventSchemaVersion,
        EventUid,
        EventOriginalUid,
        EventMessage,
        EventReportUrl,
        AlertName,
        ThreatId,
        ThreatCategory,
        RuleName,
        Rule,
        DetectionMethod,
        AttackTactics,
        AttackTechniques,
        Username,
        UsernameType,
        UserId,
        UserIdType,
        UserType,
        OriginalUserType,
        User,
        DvcId,
        DvcHostname,
        DvcIdType,
        DvcScopeId,
        DvcIpAddr,
        DvcAction,
        Dvc,
        Hostname,
        IpAddr,
        AlertId,
        AlertDescription,
        IndicatorType,
        ProcessId,
        ProcessCommandLine,
        ProcessName,
        FileName,
        FilePath,
        FileSHA1,
        FileSize,
        AdditionalFields,
        Type
};
parser(
    starttime=starttime,
    endtime=endtime,
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix,
    hostname_has_any=hostname_has_any,
    username_has_any=username_has_any,
    attacktactics_has_any=attacktactics_has_any,
    attacktechniques_has_any=attacktechniques_has_any,
    threatcategory_has_any=threatcategory_has_any,
    alertverdict_has_any=alertverdict_has_any,
    eventseverity_has_any=eventseverity_has_any,
    disabled=disabled,
    pack=pack
)
